newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA buys 25 pct of Ceres Fruit Processors.
newsitem.headline: NSA buys 25 pct of Ceres Fruit Processors.

text.p: NSA Investments Ltd said on Wednesday that it had acquired a 25 percent equity interest in Ceres Fruit Processors Ltd for 26 million rand in cash.
NSA said it had purchased the stake from Hamvos Beleggings (Pty) Ltd and AECI Ltd.
"NSA's directors believe that Ceres Fruit Processors has excellent growth potential and that it will contribute to NSA's growth in value in the future," NSA said in a statement.
Ceres is South Africa's largest producer of apple and pear juice concentrates.
Its main customers in South Africa are well established brand leaders, while 40 to 60 percent of its products are being exported to the Far East, North America and Europe.

"Ceres Fruit Processors is operating at full capacity and cannot meet local and foreign demand for its products. As part of NSA's acquisition, it has committed, together with the other shareholders, to inject additional capital to fund growth in capacity and increased efficiencies," NSA said.
Ceres' other shareholders include Ceres Holdings Ltd and Genbel Securities Ltd.
